# Pontifork

> A free, open-source tuner and chord book for cello, guitar (6 and 7 strings) and bass (4, 5 and 6 strings). It runs in any browser and as an Android app. It listens on the device: nothing is recorded and nothing is sent anywhere.

- Tunes 53 standard, lowered, drop, open, alternate and scordatura tunings, and knows which string is being tuned, so a string far off pitch is still measured against its own target.
- Counts within 5 cents as in tune; the reference pitch moves from A = 415 to 466 Hz.
- The chord book lists 120 chords (12 roots of major, minor, 7, m7, maj7, sus2, sus4, 5, dim and aug) whose shapes follow the tuning and capo in use: a C shape played half a step down is listed as B.
- Chord sequences are saved on the device and can be played through silently, two seconds per chord.

## Links

- [The tuner, in a browser](https://pontifork-online.bermeo.dev/): the web app.
- [The chord book](https://pontifork-online.bermeo.dev/chords): every chord in the tuning in use.
- [Product site](https://pontifork.bermeo.dev/): features, a six-step guide to tuning, and every tuning note by note.
- [Source code](https://github.com/GMBermeo/pontifork): MIT licensed.
- [Releases](https://github.com/GMBermeo/pontifork/releases): the Android APK.
